teaser.en: Dhow builders prized its timber for masts, yet this rare mangrove hides in the thickets at the back of the swamp, away from the sea.
teaser.sw: Mafundi wa majahazi waliuthamini mti huu kwa ajili ya milingoti, lakini mkoko huu adimu hujificha vichakani nyuma ya bwawa, mbali na bahari.

summary.en: The cedar mangrove is a shrub or small tree that grows in coral thickets and bushland at the back of the mangroves. It is rare on the Kenyan coast, and its timber was used for dhow masts and furniture.
summary.sw: Mkomafi huu ni kichaka au mti mdogo unaoota katika vichaka vya matumbawe na misitu ya vichaka nyuma ya mikoko. Ni adimu katika pwani ya Kenya, na mbao zake zilitumika kutengenezea milingoti ya majahazi na fanicha.

about.en:
The cedar mangrove is a shrub or small tree, a smaller and more retiring cousin of the cannonball mangrove. Its leaves are compound, and the leaflets are drier in texture and more pointed than those of the cannonball mangrove. Its fruit is a hard, round capsule like its relative's but noticeably smaller, and it too splits into angular seeds.

In wetter ground the tree may send up breathing roots from the mud, but where it grows among coral rock it can look like an ordinary bush tree, so it is easy to pass by without recognising it as a mangrove at all.
about.sw:
Mkomafi huu ni kichaka au mti mdogo, ndugu mdogo na mwenye haya zaidi wa mkomafi mkubwa (*cannonball mangrove*). Majani yake ni mchanganyiko, na vijani vyake ni vikavu zaidi kwa kuguswa na vimechongoka zaidi kuliko vya mkomafi mkubwa. Tunda lake ni kibuyu kigumu cha mviringo kama cha ndugu yake lakini kidogo zaidi kwa wazi, nalo pia hupasuka na kuwa mbegu zenye pembe.

Katika ardhi yenye unyevu zaidi mti huu unaweza kuchipua mizizi ya kupumulia kutoka kwenye tope, lakini pale unapoota kati ya miamba ya matumbawe unaweza kuonekana kama mti wa kawaida wa porini, hivyo ni rahisi kuupita bila kutambua kwamba ni mkoko kabisa.

where.en: It grows in coral thickets and bushland at the back of the mangroves, where the tidal swamp gives way to dry land. Unlike the zoned mangroves of the open creek, it is found here and there along the Kenyan coast rather than in stands, and it is rare. The best chance of seeing it is on the landward fringe of a mangrove walk, looking for small round fruits among the coral scrub.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vya matumbawe na misitu ya vichaka nyuma ya mikoko, pale ambapo bwawa la maji kupwa na kujaa linaishia na nchi kavu kuanza. Tofauti na mikoko inayoota kwa safu katika hori zilizo wazi, mti huu hupatikana hapa na pale katika pwani ya Kenya badala ya kuota kwa makundi, na ni adimu. Nafasi nzuri zaidi ya kuuona ni pembeni mwa njia ya kutembea mikokoni upande wa nchi kavu, ukitafuta matunda madogo ya mviringo kati ya vichaka vya matumbawe.

uses.en: Its timber was used for the masts of dhows and for furniture. Straight, strong poles from the back of the mangrove had a ready use in the coast's boat-building tradition.
uses.sw: Mbao zake zilitumika kutengenezea milingoti ya majahazi na fanicha. Boriti zilizonyooka na imara kutoka nyuma ya mikoko zilikuwa na soko la uhakika katika desturi ya ujenzi wa vyombo vya bahari pwani.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it shares the name *mkomafi* with the cannonball mangrove. In English it is the cedar mangrove, and its scientific name is *Xylocarpus moluccensis*, after the Moluccas in Indonesia, a reminder of how widely it grows around the Indian Ocean.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unashiriki jina *mkomafi* na mkomafi mkubwa (*cannonball mangrove*). Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *cedar mangrove*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Xylocarpus moluccensis*, kutokana na visiwa vya Moluccas nchini Indonesia, ukumbusho wa jinsi unavyoota kwa upana kuzunguka Bahari ya Hindi.

conservation.en: It is rare in Kenya. Globally it is Least Concern, but Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel, so harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and communities at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are restoring mangrove forest.
conservation.sw: Ni adimu nchini Kenya. Kimataifa uko katika hali ya Wasiwasi Mdogo (Least Concern), lakini mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na nishati, kwa hiyo uvunaji hupewa leseni na Shirika la Misitu la Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinarejesha misitu ya mikoko.

reason.sw: Jenasi moja, wenye matunda makubwa zaidi sana
